text: No fires were detected on the asset from **September 25, 2026**, to **October 24, 2026**, based on NASA FIRMS thermal anomaly data. The last day of the evaluated period (**October 25, 2026**) was not covered due to a temporal gap in the data. This means we cannot confirm the presence or absence of fires on that final day. However, for the entire period except October 25, no thermal anomalies (fires) were detected within the asset boundary.
